listing.title: Concepts that make digital decisions visible.
listing.intro: This portfolio shows design scenarios, not client engagements. Each entry clearly separates what's explored, what's demonstrated, and what's still to be validated.
listing.sixScenariosTitle: An honest read of what each concept demonstrates.
listing.journeyTitle: From hypothesis to a verifiable version.
listing.ctaTitle: Your project starts with a context, not a demo.
listing.ctaText: Describe the problem, the users, and the priorities to clarify.

detail.contextTitle: A design scenario, not a client engagement.
detail.ctaTitle: Describe the problem, the users, and the priorities.

garage.title: Website for a local garage
garage.summary: A showcase-website concept structuring services, appointment requests, and local information.
garage.description: A design scenario showing how a local service business could clarify its offer and make a first contact easier.
challenge: Clearly presenting a range of services.
Organizing credible local information without fake reviews or numbers.
approach: A hierarchy built around drivers' needs.
A short path from service to request.
limitations: Concept not commissioned by a garage.

seo.title: Local garage website concept
seo.description: A demo website concept for a local garage, focused on services and getting in touch.

reservation.title: Booking platform
reservation.summary: A platform concept bringing availability, requests, and confirmations into one coherent flow.
reservation.description: This concept explores a booking experience meant to reduce requests scattered across phone calls and messages.
challenge: Planning for exceptions without overloading the flow.
approach: A journey organized around picking a time slot.
A split between the public experience and internal management.

seo.title: Booking platform concept
seo.description: A demo concept for a web booking and availability-management platform.

gestion.title: Internal management application
gestion.summary: A business-tool concept centralizing clients, tasks, documents, and operational statuses.
gestion.description: An internal-application scenario designed to show how information that's scattered today could be structured.
challenge: Bringing together several sources of information.
approach: Access and permissions to be scoped before building.
limitations: Data model not validated in the field.
Security to be specified based on real data.

seo.title: Internal management application concept
seo.description: A demo concept for a business application centralizing tasks, documents, and tracking.

automation.title: Administrative automation
automation.summary: A flow concept connecting a form, filing, notifications, and a tracking dashboard.
automation.description: This concept shows how a repetitive administrative process could be mapped before a controlled automation.
approach: Mapping the flow before tooling it.
A tracking log to understand each step.

seo.title: Administrative automation concept
seo.description: A demo concept for an automated administrative flow with human checkpoints.

dashboard.title: SME dashboard
dashboard.summary: A dashboard concept giving a team a shared read of requests, tasks, and selected metrics.
dashboard.description: An interface exploration meant to help a team review its activity, with no real company data or results shown.
challenge: Prioritizing a small set of useful metrics.
Avoiding a misleading read of the data.
approach: A hierarchy organized by the decision to make.

seo.title: SME dashboard concept
seo.description: A demo dashboard concept for structuring an SME's activity tracking.

mobile.title: Mobile app for a local service
mobile.summary: A mobile concept for submitting a request, checking its status, and receiving useful updates.
mobile.description: This scenario explores a phone-based service relationship, without claiming to represent a published app.
challenge: Reducing the steps of a mobile request.
approach: Short navigation adapted to thumb use.
limitations: Visual prototype not published on any store.

seo.title: Local service mobile app concept
seo.description: A demo concept for a mobile application handling requests and status tracking for a local service.
